name: Paraglider Jas

intro.text: The wind comes off the sea, hits the scarp and goes straight up. Lovely lift. I've been airborne since breakfast. Well, on and off.

win: Brought down to earth. It happens to all of us eventually.
after: Devil's Dyke, up the way, is the place for it. The story goes the Devil dug it to let the sea in and drown the churches of the Weald. He ran out of night.
